caption:
Are Ozempic and Wegovy the same drug?

Ozempic and Wegovy both contain semaglutide. Ozempic is approved for type 2 diabetes and Wegovy for chronic weight management. Did you know this? Yes or no.

More at pepsafe.info/p/semaglutide.html
